6. Further by order dated 18.01.2019, 21.12.2019 and 22.02.2020 non-bailable warrant of arrest,
proclamations under sections 82 and 83 respectively have been issued against the petitioners which was allowed to be challenged by order dated 08.12.2021.
Thus the above orders are also under challenge.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioner no.1-Md. Zeeshan is not the husband of the O.P. No.2 and the case has been maliciously filed against the petitioners.

He submits that earlier the case was filed by one Jeba Saheen under section 498A of I.P.C against Ibadat Hussain and on the instigation of Ibadat Hussain the present false case has been filed against the petitioners.
He submits that the impugned orders are not in accordance with law.

7. Learned counsel for the State submits that the argument of the learned counsel for the petitioners is fit to be appreciated in the trial and not under section 482 of Cr.P.C.
8.
The Court has perused the order dated 05.05.2010 whereby learned court has taken cognizance against the petitioners.

What are the materials against the petitioners are not required to be disclosed in the order taking cognizance however what are the prima facie material against the petitioners is required to be taken against the petitioners which is lacking in the case in hand.

Further orders dated 18.01.2019, 21.12.2019 and 22.02.2020 are not in accordance with law.
9.

In view of above order taking cognizance dated 05.05.2010 including orders 18.01.2019,
21.12.2019 and 22.02.2020 passed in PCR Case No. 37/2010 are quashed and set aside.
10. The matter is remitted back to the concerned learned court to pass afresh order on the point of cognizance.
11. This petition stands disposed of.
Pending I.A., if any, stands disposed of.
Interim order is vacated.
